scripts.build: npx esbuild app/javascript/application.js --bundle --sourcemap --format=esm --outdir=app/assets/builds --public-path=/assets && npx esbuild app/javascript/dashboard.js --bundle --sourcemap --format=esm --outdir=app/assets/builds --public-path=/assets
scripts.build:css: npm run copy:fonts && npx sass ./app/assets/stylesheets/application.sass.scss:./app/assets/builds/application.css --no-source-map --load-path=node_modules && npx sass ./app/assets/stylesheets/dashboard.sass.scss:./app/assets/builds/dashboard.css --no-source-map --load-path=node_modules
scripts.copy:fonts: cp app/assets/fonts/*.woff2 app/assets/builds/ 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p app/assets/builds/fonts; cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* app/assets/builds/fonts/
